# arin_rdap_domains_by_nameserver (Data Source)

Find public reverse-domain registrations using an exact nameserver name. Returns complete domain records sorted by name, including DNSSEC and raw JSON. No API key is sent. No matches produce an empty list; partial results and referrals are rejected. ARIN does not support wildcards for this query.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_domains_by_nameserver" "example" {
  nameserver = "ns1.arin.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nameserver` (String) Exact ASCII nameserver hostname. Case and an optional trailing dot are normalized; no wildcards.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Related domain records ordered by name. Confirmed no matches produce an empty list; other failures remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `delegation_signed` (Boolean) Published delegationSigned flag indicating DS records in the parent. Null if omitted.
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) ds records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--ds_records))
- `events` (Attributes List) events returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--events))
- `handle` (String) handle returned by ARIN.
- `key_records` (Attributes List) key records returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--key_records))
- `max_sig_life` (Number) Published maximum signature lifetime in seconds. Null if omitted.
- `name` (String) name returned by ARIN.
- `nameservers` (Attributes List) nameservers returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--nameservers))
- `network_handle` (String) network handle returned by ARIN.
- `org_handles` (List of String) org handles returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete domain JSON, including embedded network/entity records, DNSSEC metadata, links and extensions. No links are followed.
- `status` (List of String) status returned by ARIN.
- `unicode_name` (String) unicode name returned by ARIN.
- `zone_signed` (Boolean) Published zoneSigned flag. Null if omitted; this provider does not validate DNS signatures.

- `key_tag` (Number) key tag returned by ARIN.
